Players Committee card image of [[Rebel Flight Suit (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on a Rebel (or Resistance) pilot. Any starfighter or vehicle character pilots is power +2. If present at a site, may use 1 Force to place this device in Used Pile. Once per game, if character is piloting in battle, may cancel a non-[S] Interrupt.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/rebelflightsuit.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
